title: Google's Name Is Actually a Typo
description:
One of the most valuable brand names on Earth exists because of a spelling mistake nobody bothered to fix. Here's the real story.

#shorts #techfacts #google

scenes.text: Google is one of the most recognized names on the planet. It's also, technically, a typo.
The founders wanted a name based on 'googol,' the mathematical term for the number one followed by a hundred zeros.
It was meant to represent the huge amount of information the search engine would organize.
When a colleague checked if the domain was available, he misspelled it as g-o-o-g-l-e instead of g-o-o-g-o-l.
The founders liked it anyway, and registered google.com in September of 1997.
So the correct spelling of the idea was never actually used. The typo became the trillion dollar brand.
